item.title: Middle East Escalation Could Leave 11.7 Million More Women and Girls Facing Food Insecurity by End-2026
item.description: Disruption to the Strait of Hormuz is driving up food prices and putting further strain on the livelihoods and household resources of millions of women and girls, according to a new UN Women analysis.

item.title: Disasters cost $228 billion in housing losses every year
item.description: $228 billion is a staggering amount of money to find, but that’s exactly what communities around the world are faced with every year, to rebuild housing after disaster strikes.

item.title: Global action to end violence against children is lagging behind risks: UN expert
item.description: The UN Special Representative on Violence Against Children has called for stronger global action to protect boys and girls caught up in a growing number of crises, as current efforts fall short.

item.title: 800 million young people face a future without jobs
item.description: Approximately 800 million young people entering the labour market in developing economies over the coming years will not find jobs unless countries act, the head of the UN Development Programme (UNDP) warned on Tuesday, as the agency launched two initiatives to boost investment and employment.

item.title: World News in Brief: West African migrant crossings, Argentina takes UK to maritime tribunal, farming in Gaza, mental health update
item.description: Fewer people from West Africa are reaching Europe by sea, but the journey has not become safer, the UN migration agency (IOM) said on Tuesday.

item.title: ‘Need for UN has never been greater,’ UN chief says, proposing slimmer $3.3 billion budget for 2027
item.description: Amid climate disruption, an AI revolution, war and growing hunger, “the need for the United Nations has never been greater,” Secretary-General António Guterres said on Tuesday, presenting a $3.3 billion programme budget proposal for next year – a cut of $40.8 million.

item.title: Ukraine: Residents killed and dozens injured in attacks on Kharkiv and Kyiv
item.description: Russian attacks in recent days on on Ukraine’s two largest cities have again killed and injured civilians, damaged homes and civilian infrastructure, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) said on Tuesday.
